# splunkctl conf

Generic conf file/stanza editor (any conf, including sensitive ones).

## conf files

List conf files known to the server.

```text
splunkctl conf files [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | Scope conf-file visibility to one app (default: current namespace). |
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |

## conf get

Show a conf stanza's keys, or one key's value with --key.

```text
splunkctl conf get [OPTIONS] FILE STANZA
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | App to resolve the stanza in, when the same stanza exists in more than one app (default: current namespace). |
| `--key` | text | - | Show only this key's value. |

## conf list

List stanzas in a conf file.

```text
splunkctl conf list [OPTIONS] FILE
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | text | - | Only stanzas in this app (default: current namespace, which may miss app-private stanzas — pass --app to see them all). |
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |

## conf reload

Reload a conf file so its changes take effect.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl conf reload [OPTIONS] FILE
```

## conf set

Set KEY=VALUE pairs on a conf stanza (creates it if absent).

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl conf set [OPTIONS] FILE STANZA PAIRS...
```

## conf unset

Clear keys on a conf stanza (REST cannot delete a key; sets empty).

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl conf unset [OPTIONS] FILE STANZA KEYS...
```
